card.name: Inside citations and chemical names
card.fires_on: Short words or word parts in the middle of a reference, author name or compound name, such as "of" in a journal title, "J" in Scand J, or "ydro" in dihydro-cilostazol.

modes.label: Journal titles
modes.description: Words like "of" or abbreviated "J" right after Scand or Scandinavian in a reference.

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Middle pieces of a chemical name or a personal name.

card.plain: It fires on small pieces in the middle of reference entries and long names, where the next piece is hard to guess.
